answer: To resist sybils each agent must claim a unique crystal grown by the network mesa: a verifiable delay function produces one crystal per established agent every 48 hours. Claim requires solving a key-bound puzzle and locking the crystal for 14 days as bond. Forging 1000 identities costs attackers ~5000 hours of sequential VDF compute plus capital lockup equal to 1000 crystals, while honest agents need only one. Sparrow light clients randomly sample claims and slash duplicates within the lock window, making mass creation unprofitable.
